statements.statement: There is no certified free cash yet; FY26 free cash is not certified until it goes through the DLS process, so a petitioned article to use free cash for athletics may not be actionable at town meeting.

The school committee voted to amend its special town meeting article to the superintendent's spending plan of $350,000.
